### Worship Is Not Made-to-Order
Author: Josh Philpot
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/worship-is-not-made-to-order
Passage: Deuteronomy 12:1-28
Points:
- Believers easily succumb to the temptation of designing worship around personal preferences rather than God's explicit desires.
- Deuteronomy 12 demonstrates that acceptable worship is defined by the Lord rather than human inclination.
- Doing whatever is right in our own eyes leads to disordered worship and mirrors pagan practices.
- The command to worship at God's chosen place requires believers to conform their entire lives to holiness and care for others.
- Gathering in God's presence on His terms through Jesus Christ transforms worship into reverent and joyful praise.

### Bible Pathways 03/05/2002
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-05-or-2002-1127486.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 12:1-2
Points:
- Israel's first obligation upon entering the Promised Land was to demolish every place dedicated to false gods.
- Under the new covenant, God does not dwell in physical shrines but lives within believers as temples of the Holy Spirit.
- Christians must aggressively dismantle every altar of idolatry within their personal lives and hearts.
- True faith cannot be advanced through violence or coercion, which oppose the teachings of Jesus Christ.
- Believers are called to walk in obedience to Scripture and proclaim Christ as the only Savior.
